---
title: "OWIMD: GDP-adjusted region means, old vs. new"
subtitle: "Residuals from a GDP-only model (old) vs. partial residuals from modR (new), after Gavin's notes"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
    page-layout: full
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
# run the post's code up to the MANCOVA model, modR
# (purl in a separate R process: it can't run inside this knit)
tf <- normalizePath(tempfile(fileext = ".R"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
        c("-e", shQuote(sprintf("knitr::purl('index.qmd', output = '%s', quiet = TRUE)", tf))))
code <- readLines(tf)
eval(parse(text = code[1:grep("^modR <-", code)]))
library(candisc)

# old: residuals from a model with GDP alone
Z_old <- resid(lm(Z ~ ns(logGDP, 3), data = cc))
# new: partial residuals from modR (responses minus the fitted GDP part)
X <- model.matrix(modR)
gdp <- grep("ns(logGDP", colnames(X), fixed = TRUE)
Z_new <- scale(Z - X[, gdp] %*% coef(modR)[gdp, ], scale = FALSE)

means_old <- aggregate(Z_old, list(region = cc$region), mean)
means_new <- aggregate(Z_new, list(region = cc$region), mean)
```

## Fig 5: HE plot for LifeExp and LifeSat

The ellipses are the same in both. Only the dots (adjusted region means) change.

```{r fig5}
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: ["Old: means of residuals from GDP alone", "New: means of partial residuals from modR"]
vars <- c("LifeExp", "LifeSat")
he <- function(m) {
  heplot(modR, variables = vars, factor.means = FALSE, fill = TRUE, fill.alpha = 0.1,
         label.cex = 1.15, term.labels = c("GDP (spline)", "region"))
  points(m[, vars], pch = 16, cex = 1.2)
  text(m[, vars], labels = m$region, pos = c(3, 1, 3, 3, 3), cex = 1.1)
}
he(means_old)
he(means_new)
```

```{r means-table}
tab <- cbind(means_old[, vars], means_new[, vars])
names(tab) <- paste(rep(c("old", "new"), each = 2), vars)
rownames(tab) <- means_old$region
knitr::kable(round(tab, 2), caption = "Adjusted region means, LifeExp and LifeSat")

ratio <- apply(as.matrix(means_new[, -1]), 2, sd) / apply(as.matrix(means_old[, -1]), 2, sd)
knitr::kable(t(round(ratio, 2)), caption = "Spread of the region means, new / old, by outcome")
```

## Fig 6: HE plot matrix

Unchanged: it shows only the ellipses, with no region means.

## Fig 7: canonical discriminant plot

```{r fig7}
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: ["Old: canonical analysis of residuals from GDP alone", "New: canonical analysis of partial residuals from modR"]
can_old <- candisc(lm(Z_old ~ region, data = cc), term = "region")
can_new <- candisc(lm(Z_new ~ region, data = cc), term = "region")
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(nlevels(cc$region))
plot(can_old, var.lwd = 2, var.col = "black", ellipse = TRUE, rev.axes = c(TRUE, TRUE),
     scale = 4, col = cols)
plot(can_new, var.lwd = 2, var.col = "black", ellipse = TRUE, rev.axes = c(TRUE, TRUE),
     scale = 4, col = cols)
```

```{r can-table}
knitr::kable(rbind(old = round(can_old$pct[1:4], 1), new = round(can_new$pct[1:4], 1)),
             col.names = paste0("Can", 1:4), caption = "Percent of region variation, by dimension")
knitr::kable(round(cbind(can_old$structure[, 1:2], can_new$structure[, 1:2]) %*%
                     diag(c(-1, -1, -1, -1)), 2),
             col.names = c("old Can1", "old Can2", "new Can1", "new Can2"),
             caption = "Structure correlations, with both axes reversed as plotted")
```
